annotate_discard.already: Already discarded. What you asked of this session was discarded earlier, so this press deleted nothing and the earlier record stands.
annotate_discard.armed: Press it again to discard. Everything you asked of this session will go, along with any reading of it and this session's summary, including one being written, and nothing raised against those words will quote them any more; the record that a check ran stays. Nothing has been deleted yet, and this offer lapses in 30 seconds.
annotate_discard.held: Not discarded. This session's words were saved by a build of Compass that can read more than this one, so nothing was changed. Discard them from that build, or remove this session's entry from compass-annotations.json.
annotate_discard.nothing: Nothing to discard. Nothing was typed against this session, so nothing was deleted and no record of a deletion was made.
annotate_discard.record: What you asked of this session was discarded, along with any reading of it. None of it is kept here: this record says only that the act happened and when. Where session history is recording, it holds its own fourteen-day copy of the goal and each outcome line, and --forget deletes that store.
annotate_discard.record_standing: The departure store could not be written when they went, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them.
annotate_discard.refused: Not discarded. The server refused, so what you asked of this session is still stored and nothing raised against it was withdrawn.
annotate_discard.stored: Discarded. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it and its summary, and nothing raised against those words quotes them any more. The record that a check ran stays, because it is what bounds how often one may run. Opening a finished session again writes a new summary unless summaries are turned off.
annotate_discard.stored_no_summary: Discarded. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it, and nothing raised against those words quotes them any more. This session had no stored summary. The record that a check ran stays, because it is what bounds how often one may run. Opening a finished session again writes a new summary unless summaries are turned off.
annotate_discard.summary_kept: Discarded here, but this session's summary could not be deleted, so any summary stored for it is still stored. Delete summary removes it.
annotate_discard.summary_stopped: Discarded. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it, and nothing raised against those words quotes them any more. This session had no stored summary, and the one being written was stopped. The record that a check ran stays, because it is what bounds how often one may run. Opening a finished session again writes a new summary unless summaries are turned off.
annotate_discard.summary_unavailable: Discarded here. The summary store could not be read, so Compass cannot say whether a summary of this session is stored, and none was deleted.
annotate_discard.summary_unknown: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it, and nothing raised against those words quotes them any more. Compass could not tell what happened to this session's summary, so any summary stored for it may still be stored.
annotate_discard.unreadable: What you asked of this session was discarded, so there is nothing left to read it against.
annotate_discard.untrusted: Not discarded. Compass could not read compass-annotations.json, so nothing was saved and nothing was overwritten. Move or repair that file to save again.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_absent: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. This session had no stored summary.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_deleted: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. Its summary was deleted.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_kept: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. Its summary could not be deleted, so any summary stored for it is still stored. Delete summary removes it.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_stopped: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. This session had no stored summary, and the one being written was stopped.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_unavailable: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. The summary store could not be read, so Compass cannot say whether a summary of this session is stored, and none was deleted.
annotate_discard.unwithdrawn_unknown: Discarded here. Everything you asked of this session is gone, along with any reading of it. The departure store could not be written, so anything raised against those words goes on quoting them. Compass could not tell what happened to its summary, so any summary stored for it may still be stored.
annotate_discard.unwritable: Not discarded. The store could not be written, so the next collection reads what you asked of this session back and nothing raised against it was withdrawn.
annotate_discard.why: Discarding everything deletes all you asked of this session, any reading of it, and this session's summary, and nothing raised against those words quotes them any more. It keeps the record that a check ran, which bounds how often one may run. Session history, where it is recording, keeps its own fourteen-day copy, and --forget deletes that store. The clear beside the goal is the weaker act: the save after it keeps your earlier saves.

summaries.disclosure: Sends to Anthropic through your Claude Code, at most 16 KiB at a time: your messages, text relayed in your turn, the agent's replies, check names with their result (failed, passed or not recorded), and the paths of files written. Titles of earlier parts go along as context, and the entries a summary cites are sent again for its opening line. Everything is redacted first. No command, file or other tool output is sent. Turn off summaries stops these calls; Turn summaries on restores them.
